notes.title: Important news - the game is delayed a little bit ⏳
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! 

We were planning to release the game on Monday, but we've found several minor issues that require polishing before we're ready to present our fans with the fresh release. 

We'll prepare a little surprise along with the release to compensate for the wait - wishlist the game so you won't miss it!

We've worked a lot to improve the quality and address the aspects our audience told us about - unlike in our previous game, Sex of Thrones, dialogue won't interrupt scenes anymore, and we've added an interesting gameplay mechanic of fighting based off of skills you improve and dice rolls - we're eager to hear what you think of it!

Thank you for your patience and prepare for an unforgettable adventure! [/h3]🎮
